## `WaveformView` — Canvas-based, EMBRY dark theme

**File:** `packages/ux-lab/src/components/music-lab/WaveformView.tsx` (303 lines)

### Architecture
Replaced the SVG implementation with a `useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>` + `useEffect` Canvas 2D pipeline. All drawing happens imperatively in a single effect, re-running whenever any prop changes.

### Drawing layers (bottom → top)
| Layer | Description |
|---|---|
| **Background** | `EMBRY.bgCard` (`#1a1a1a`) fill |
| **Drift highlights** | Semi-transparent red rects (`rgba(#ff4444, 0.12)`) spanning the full waveform height for every beat where `drift_ms > driftThreshold` |
| **Beat grid** | Bar lines (heavier, 40% muted) + sub-beat lines (16% muted) |
| **Centre line** | Dashed mid-amplitude reference |
| **Waveform peaks** | Mirrored bar chart — verse blue (`#4a9eff`), chorus purple (`#7c3aed`); upper half 75% alpha, mirror 35% |
| **Beat alignment overlay** | Blue tick = **expected** beat (piano-roll spec); red tick = **actual** beat; amber arrow connector when they diverge |
| **Drift markers** | Downward amber/red triangles; `{n}ms` label only for bad drifts |
| **Bar labels** | Monospace x-axis numbers |
| **Lyrics** | Green ticks + text anchored at beat positions below waveform |

### New exported type
```ts
export interface BeatAlignment {
  expectedBeat: number  // per piano-roll spec
  actualBeat: number    // measured position
}
```

### Props
```ts
peaks: number[]           // pre-computed amplitudes 0–1
bpm: number
totalBars: number
driftMarkers?: DriftMarker[]
lyrics?: LyricMarker[]
beatAlignments?: BeatAlignment[]   // NEW — expected vs actual
driftThreshold?: number             // default 50ms
```
